This page contains a single full-page advertisement:

**Sandoz Chemical Works, Basle (Switzerland)** — manufacturers of aniline colours for all textile trades (direct, basic, acid, sulphur, mordant colours), specialities for silk, leather, paper, lakes; printing colours, Chromosol-Mordant, and Chlorophyll for soap makers, perfumery, confectionery and liqueurs. English branch works: The Clayton Aniline Co. Ltd, Manchester; British branches: Sandoz Chemical Co. Ltd., Bradford and Manchester.
